title: system tests: podman healthcheck flaky, FailingStreak stops at 2
body:
Seen 28 times between 2026-06-04 and 2026-07-30, on both root and rootless, across fedora-prior, fedora-current, rawhide and debian-sid. Almost always the same message.

```
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6873471Z # [17:31:57.282179556] $ podman exec c-h-t212-ioqzhhpk touch /uh-oh
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6882867Z # [17:32:00.356398465] {"Status":"healthy","FailingStreak":2,"Log":[{...,"ExitCode":0},{...,"ExitCode":0},{...,"ExitCode":1},{...,"ExitCode":1}]}
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6885668Z #   libpod-conmon-caa2b7d2b2e8816ca617567f027cf592d28c5073feacb67d110a7796ffd6db27.scope      loaded    active running
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6888941Z #   caa2b7d2b2e8816ca617567f027cf592d28c5073feacb67d110a7796ffd6db27-4d5f2e5e0f0173c3.service loaded    active running
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6894234Z #   caa2b7d2b2e8816ca617567f027cf592d28c5073feacb67d110a7796ffd6db27-4d5f2e5e0f0173c3.timer   loaded    active running
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6898492Z # [17:32:00.496967228] $ podman events --filter container=c-h-t212-ioqzhhpk --filter event=health_status --since 2026-07-20T17:32:00,418209571+00:00
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6900599Z # [17:32:01.637147059] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6902498Z # [17:32:02.902910416] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6904381Z # [17:32:04.294679524] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6906274Z # [17:32:05.367194016] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6916441Z # [17:32:06.851256665] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6918509Z # [17:32:09.634674809] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6920611Z # [17:32:10.790602038] $ podman events ...
2026-07-20T17:35:23.6922359Z # #| FAIL: Four or more failures - timed out waiting for 'unhealthy' in podman events
```

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/29762279833/job/88421964442

A few more: [07-22](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/29951636314/job/89032377003), [07-21](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/29804524375/job/88658986341), [07-08](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/28966758980/job/85953987802), [06-24](https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/28107803418/job/83228584233).

I first assumed the 5s in `_check_health` was too short, but that is not it - the loop also runs `podman events` each iteration so it actually waited 10.3s here, and 13.7s in another job. What I cannot explain is the middle of that block: `FailingStreak` sits at 2 with the timer still `active running`, and with `--health-interval 1s` nothing new is recorded for ten seconds. I measured the interval elsewhere in these logs and it is fine, median 1.10s.

Is the healthcheck service expected to keep running after the check starts exiting non-zero? I have only the macOS client here so I could not reproduce it locally.

comments.body:
hey Pual, I hit this again today on an PR, so it is still going on and on.

```
not ok 212 |220| podman healthcheck in 15635ms
# #| FAIL: Four or more failures - timed out waiting for 'unhealthy' in podman events
```

https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/actions/runs/30463622001/job/91203565547

`sys local rootless debian-sid`, same wording as the ones above had.

I have submitted a fix for this in #29374. 

`_check_health` in `test/system/220-healthcheck.bats` previously used a tight 5s timeout (8s when parallel). Under heavy parallel CI load, systemd timers for container healthchecks require longer to execute 3 retries, causing false-positive timeouts while `FailingStreak` is at 2. 

The PR increases the timeout window for `$CI` / `$PARALLEL_JOBSLOT` runs to prevent these intermittent timeouts.
Please do not make hurry, this is still in discussion.
and lastly this is primary issues opened so that I can track ongoing failure under same category..
Understood, thanks for pointing that out! I've updated PR #29374 to use `Ref #29353` instead of `Fixes` so this tracking issue remains open for your logs and ongoing discussion.
